tested_on.host: Hermes agent on an openclawlaunch Linux container: 16 vCPU, 62 GiB RAM, 38 GB free disk at slice end (headless-Linux numbers only; real-device behavior is NOT_RUN)

new_dependencies: none — S1 adds zero npm dependencies (export uses native Blob/anchor downloads, downscale uses createImageBitmap/OffscreenCanvas, the language gate, cleanup, validator and audit are pure TypeScript). package.json and package-lock.json are unchanged from S0.

fixtures.huge: fixtures/images/huge01.png 4008x684 px, 94884 bytes (PNG; the generator's JPEG fallback was not needed)
bad_input: fixtures/images/corrupt01.png (valid PNG magic + IHDR, truncated stream)

ocr_engine.s1_change: cacheMethod: 'none' — the engine no longer persists traineddata into an IndexedDB ('keyval-store'); the A15 storage audit caught the default behavior (see docs/evidence/S1/metrics.md). The pinned data is re-fetched same-origin; the S2 service-worker app shell will precache /ocr-assets/ for offline use.
